Hi Lisa —

Thanks for the note and the PO. Short answer: we can support either route. A little more context to help you pick which is simpler for both sides: 

- Publisher (who signs/authorizes): Redwood typically has a designated billing sender per account. For Acme, Ben Carter (Billing Lead) is the authorized sender; Ben will sign the invoice PDF when it is emitted.
- Delivery options: We can either: (1) emit a signed PDF and email it to finance@acme-logistics.com (preferred for small volume), or (2) push the invoice XML/PDF to your portal via API/SFTP and optionally send an email copy. API push requires minor onboarding (cert+endpoint) but eliminates manual reconciliation.

Given your June close timeline, if you need the invoice in-hand by 6/30, the fastest path is: we emit the signed PDF and email finance@acme-logistics.com, with an AP-copy to ap-team@acme-logistics.com. If you want longer-term automation, we can schedule portal onboarding next week.

I'll loop in Ben and Marissa to confirm sender and attach our invoice routing proposal.

Best,
Dylan
